title: antirrhinum fruticosum
intro: Antirrhinum fruticosum, commonly known as the snapdragon, is a perennial herbaceous flowering plant that belongs to the family Plantaginaceae. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and anxiety, improving sleep quality, and supporting respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Antirrhinum fruticosum are attributed to its ability to exert a sedative effect, calm the nervous system, and act as an expectorant. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
